questions.question_text: The diagram shows a straight line intersecting 2 parallel lines. Find the value of x and the value of y.
Calculate ((20.2 - 1.7^{2})^{\frac{1}{3}}) / 5.1. Give your answer correct to 4 decimal places.
The exchange rate between pounds and rupees is 1 pound = 350.4 rupees. Convert 84 000 rupees into pounds.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x).
Write down the zeros of f(x).
Write down the coordinates of the local minimum point.
The equation f(x) = k has no solutions. Find the range of values of k.
Solve the equation f(x) = 20 + 10x.
On the diagram, sketch the line x = -2.
Shade and label the region R where x \le -2, y \ge f(x) and y \le 20 + 10x.
Solve the simultaneous equations. You must show all your working. 3x - y = 1, 5x + 2y = -24
The price of a computer is reduced by 10%. The price of the computer is then reduced by a further 15%. Calculate the overall percentage reduction in the price of the computer.
On the grid, draw the cumulative frequency diagram.
Use your cumulative frequency diagram to find an estimate of the median
Use your cumulative frequency diagram to find an estimate of the number of plants with a height greater than 30 cm.
Complete the frequency table for the 100 plants.
Calculate an estimate of the mean.
v = \begin{pmatrix} k \\ 4.35 \end{pmatrix}, |v| = 5.33. Find the value of k.

The diagram shows a solid made with a cone, a cylinder and a hemisphere. The radius of each of the cone, the cylinder and the hemisphere is 12 cm. The height of the cone is 15 cm. The height of the cylinder is 10 cm. Calculate the total surface area of the solid.
The diagram shows a sector of a circle. The perimeter of the sector is 48.4 cm. Calculate the area of the sector.
y = x^{3} - a. Rearrange the formula to make x the subject.
y \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{x+1}}. When x = 8, y = 5. Find y when x = 24.
Rob invests his $500 at a rate of 2.5% per year simple interest. Calculate the total value of Rob's investment at the end of 4 years.
Sal invests her $500 at a rate of 1.95% per year compound interest. Calculate the value of Sal's investment at the end of 4 years.
Find the number of complete years it takes for the total value of Sal's investment of $500 to be first greater than $800.
The diagram shows a quadrilateral ABCD with diagonal BD. Calculate AB.
Calculate angle CBD.
Calculate the area of triangle ABC.
The diagram shows a right-angled triangle. Calculate the value of w.
Simplify. \frac{1-2x}{ab - 2abx + 2x - 1}
Solid A is mathematically similar to solid B. The surface area of solid A is 383 cm^{2}. The surface area of solid B is 792 cm^{2}. The volume of solid B is 1810 cm^{3}. Find the volume of solid A.
Solve 1 + \tan x = -1 for 0^\circ \le x \le 180^\circ.
